void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool has_word(string[] items, string value)
    for item := items[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

bool has_vertex(nat[] items, nat value)
    for item := items[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

nat word_index(string[] items, string value)
    for: item := items[i]
        if item == value
            return i
    return #items

string yes_no(bool value)
    return if value then "yes" else "no"

class Edge(nat u, nat v, int capacity, cost := 0)
    lower := 0
    flow := 0

nat arc_index(int arc)
    return nat(if arc > 0 then arc - 1 else -arc - 1)

nat arc_start(Edge[] edges, int arc)
    return if arc > 0 then edges[arc_index(arc)].u else edges[arc_index(arc)].v

nat arc_end(Edge[] edges, int arc)
    return if arc > 0 then edges[arc_index(arc)].v else edges[arc_index(arc)].u

int arc_residual(Edge[] edges, int arc)
    edge := edges[arc_index(arc)]
    return if arc > 0 then edge.capacity - edge.flow else edge.flow

int arc_cost(Edge[] edges, int arc)
    return if arc > 0 then edges[arc_index(arc)].cost else -edges[arc_index(arc)].cost

Edge[] fresh_edges(Edge[] edges)
    return [for edge := edges[] then Edge(edge.u, edge.v, edge.capacity, edge.cost)]

int outflow(Edge[] edges, nat vertex)
    result := 0
    for edge := edges[]
        if edge.u == vertex
            result += edge.flow
    return result

int inflow(Edge[] edges, nat vertex)
    result := 0
    for edge := edges[]
        if edge.v == vertex
            result += edge.flow
    return result

int flow_value(Edge[] edges, nat vertex)
    return outflow(edges, vertex) - inflow(edges, vertex)

int total_cost(Edge[] edges)
    result := 0
    for edge := edges[]
        result += edge.flow * edge.cost
    return result

class Breadth(int[] levels, int[] parents)
class PathResult(bool found, int unit_cost, int[] path)
class Push(bool found, int amount, int[] path, marker := 0, unit_cost := 0)
class DinicResult(nat phases, Push[] pushes)
class CostResult(int amount, int cost, Push[] pushes)

class FlowGraph(nat count, Edge[] edge_list, int[][] arcs, int[] global_arcs)
    Breadth breadth_first(nat source, threshold := 1)
        levels := array(count, fill = -1)
        parents := array(count, fill = 0)
        levels[source] = 0
        queue := [source]
        nat at := 0
        while at < #queue
            vertex := queue[at]
            at += 1
            for arc := arcs[vertex][]
                target := arc_end(edge_list, arc)
                if arc_residual(edge_list, arc) >= threshold and levels[target] < 0
                    levels[target] = levels[vertex] + 1
                    parents[target] = arc
                    queue = queue.append(target)
        return Breadth(levels, parents)

    int[] trace_path(int[] parents, nat source, nat sink)
        int[] result := []
        vertex := sink
        while vertex != source
            arc := parents[vertex]
            result = result.append(arc)
            vertex = arc_start(edge_list, arc)
        return result[::-1]

    int bottleneck(int[] path)
        result := arc_residual(edge_list, path[0])
        for arc := path[]
            capacity := arc_residual(edge_list, arc)
            if capacity < result
                result = capacity
        return result

    void .push_path(int[] path, int amount)
        for arc := path[]
            edge_list[arc_index(arc)].flow += if arc > 0 then amount else -amount

    Push .augment(nat source, nat sink, threshold := 1)
        Breadth search := breadth_first(source, threshold)
        if search.levels[sink] < 0
            return Push(false, 0, [])
        int[] path := trace_path(search.parents, source, sink)
        int amount := bottleneck(path)
        .push_path(path, amount)
        return Push(true, amount, path, threshold)

    Push[] .edmonds_karp(nat source, nat sink)
        Push[] result := []
        while true
            Push item := .augment(source, sink)
            if not item.found
                return result
            result = result.append(item)

    DinicResult .dinic(nat source, nat sink)
        nat phases := 0
        Push[] result := []
        while true
            Breadth search := breadth_first(source)
            if search.levels[sink] < 0
                return DinicResult(phases, result)
            phases += 1
            nat[] pointers := array(count, fill = 0)
            int[] path := []
            vertex := source
            while true
                if vertex == sink
                    int amount := bottleneck(path)
                    .push_path(path, amount)
                    result = result.append(Push(true, amount, path, int(phases)))
                    path = []
                    vertex = source
                elif pointers[vertex] == #arcs[vertex]
                    if vertex == source
                        break
                    arc := path[-1]
                    path = path[:<#path - 1]
                    vertex = arc_start(edge_list, arc)
                    pointers[vertex] += 1
                else
                    arc := arcs[vertex][pointers[vertex]]
                    target := arc_end(edge_list, arc)
                    if arc_residual(edge_list, arc) > 0 and search.levels[target] == search.levels[vertex] + 1
                        path = path.append(arc)
                        vertex = target
                    else
                        pointers[vertex] += 1

    Push[] .scaling(nat source, nat sink)
        largest := 0
        for edge := edge_list[]
            if edge.capacity > largest
                largest = edge.capacity
        threshold := 1
        while threshold * 2 <= largest
            threshold *= 2
        Push[] result := []
        while threshold >= 1
            while true
                Push item := .augment(source, sink, threshold)
                if not item.found
                    break
                result = result.append(item)
            threshold /= 2
        return result

    PathResult cheapest_path(nat source, nat sink)
        usable := [for arc := global_arcs[] if arc_residual(edge_list, arc) > 0 then arc]
        known := array(count, fill = false)
        distance := array(count, fill = 0)
        parents := array(count, fill = 0)
        known[source] = true
        while true
            changed := false
            for arc := usable[]
                first := arc_start(edge_list, arc)
                last := arc_end(edge_list, arc)
                if not known[first]
                    continue
                candidate := distance[first] + arc_cost(edge_list, arc)
                if not known[last] or candidate < distance[last]
                    distance[last] = candidate
                    known[last] = true
                    parents[last] = arc
                    changed = true
            if not changed
                break
        return PathResult(known[sink], distance[sink], if known[sink] then trace_path(parents, source, sink) else [])

    CostResult .minimum_cost(nat source, nat sink, target := -1)
        amount := 0
        cost := 0
        Push[] result := []
        while target < 0 or amount < target
            PathResult search := cheapest_path(source, sink)
            if not search.found
                break
            int delta := bottleneck(search.path)
            if target >= 0 and delta > target - amount
                delta = target - amount
            .push_path(search.path, delta)
            amount += delta
            cost += delta * search.unit_cost
            result = result.append(Push(true, delta, search.path, 0, search.unit_cost))
        return CostResult(amount, cost, result)

FlowGraph graph_for(nat count, Edge[] edges)
    all_arcs := [for i := (nat(0):<#edges)[] then int(i + 1)]
    all_arcs = all_arcs.concat([for i := (nat(0):<#edges)[] then -int(i + 1)])
    adjacency := [for vertex := (0:<nat(count))[] then [for arc := all_arcs[] if arc_start(edges, arc) == vertex then arc]]
    return FlowGraph(count, edges, adjacency, all_arcs)

bool negative_cycle(nat count, Edge[] edges)
    distance := array(count, fill = 0)
    for: round < count
        changed := false
        for edge := edges[]
            candidate := distance[edge.u] + edge.cost
            if candidate < distance[edge.v]
                distance[edge.v] = candidate
                changed = true
        if not changed
            return false
        if round + 1 == count
            return true
    return false

int maximum_amount(nat count, Edge[] edges, nat source, nat sink)
    graph := graph_for(count, edges)
    ignored := .graph.edmonds_karp(source, sink)
    return flow_value(graph.edge_list, source)

class FlowPiece(bool cycle, nat origin, nat[] edges, int amount)

FlowPiece[] decompose(nat count, Edge[] edges)
    remaining := [for edge := edges[] then edge.flow]
    balance := [for vertex := (0:<nat(count))[] then flow_value(edges, vertex)]
    FlowPiece[] pieces := []
    while true
        first_edge := #edges
        for: i < #edges
            if remaining[i] > 0
                first_edge = i
                break
        if first_edge == #edges
            return pieces
        origin := edges[first_edge].u
        for: vertex < count
            if balance[vertex] > 0
                origin = vertex
                break
        walk := [origin]
        nat[] used := []
        while true
            vertex := walk[-1]
            nat selected := 0
            for: edge := edges[i]
                if edge.u == vertex and remaining[i] > 0
                    selected = i
                    break
            target := edges[selected].v
            used = used.append(selected)
            repeated := #walk
            for: item := walk[i]
                if item == target
                    repeated = i
                    break
            if repeated < #walk
                cycle := used[repeated:]
                amount := remaining[cycle[0]]
                for i := cycle[]
                    if remaining[i] < amount
                        amount = remaining[i]
                for i := cycle[]
                    remaining[i] -= amount
                pieces = pieces.append(FlowPiece(true, target, cycle, amount))
                break
            walk = walk.append(target)
            if balance[target] < 0
                amount := if balance[origin] < -balance[target] then balance[origin] else -balance[target]
                for i := used[]
                    if remaining[i] < amount
                        amount = remaining[i]
                for i := used[]
                    remaining[i] -= amount
                balance[origin] -= amount
                balance[target] += amount
                pieces = pieces.append(FlowPiece(false, origin, used, amount))
                break

string path_notation(string[] names, Edge[] edges, nat origin, int[] path)
    words := [names[origin]]
    for arc := path[]
        words = words.append((if arc > 0 then "+" else "-") + "{arc_index(arc) + 1}")
        words = words.append(names[arc_end(edges, arc)])
    return words.join(" ")

class Link(nat left, nat right)
class Matching(nat left_count, nat right_count, Link[] links)
    left_partner := array(left_count, fill = -1)
    right_partner := array(right_count, fill = -1)
    examined := array(right_count, fill = false)

    bool .try_left(nat vertex)
        for link := links[]
            if link.left != vertex or examined[link.right]
                continue
            examined[link.right] = true
            int partner := right_partner[link.right]
            if partner < 0 or .try_left(nat(partner))
                right_partner[link.right] = int(vertex)
                left_partner[vertex] = int(link.right)
                return true
        return false

    void .solve()
        for: vertex < left_count
            examined = array(right_count, fill = false)
            bool found := .try_left(vertex)

void | error matching_report(string[] args)
    left := args[0].split(",")
    right := args[1].split(",")
    string[] seen := []
    for name := left.concat(right)[]
        if has_word(seen, name)
            return error("DUPLICATE VERTEX {name}")
        seen = seen.append(name)
    Link[] links := []
    string[] pairs := if args[2] == "-" then [] else args[2].split(",")
    for pair := pairs[]
        names := pair.split("-")
        a := word_index(left, names[0])
        b := word_index(right, names[1])
        if a == #left
            return error("UNKNOWN VERTEX {names[0]}")
        if b == #right
            return error("UNKNOWN VERTEX {names[1]}")
        for link := links[]
            if link.left == a and link.right == b
                return error("DUPLICATE PAIR {pair}")
        links = links.append(Link(a, b))
    matching := Matching(#left, #right, links)
    .matching.solve()
    left_in := [for partner := matching.left_partner[] then partner < 0]
    right_in := array(#right, fill = false)
    while true
        changed := false
        for link := links[]
            if left_in[link.left] and not right_in[link.right] and matching.left_partner[link.left] != int(link.right)
                right_in[link.right] = true
                changed = true
        for: partner := matching.right_partner[b]
            if right_in[b] and partner >= 0 and not left_in[nat(partner)]
                left_in[nat(partner)] = true
                changed = true
        if not changed
            break
    size := #[for partner := matching.left_partner[] if partner >= 0 then partner]
    emit("MATCH size={size} left={#left} right={#right}")
    for: partner := matching.left_partner[a]
        if partner >= 0
            emit("PAIR {left[a]} {right[nat(partner)]}")
    free_left := [for a := left.indices()[] if matching.left_partner[a] < 0 then left[a]]
    free_right := [for b := right.indices()[] if matching.right_partner[b] < 0 then right[b]]
    emit("FREE " + (if #free_left == 0 then "-" else free_left.join(",")) + " " + (if #free_right == 0 then "-" else free_right.join(",")))
    cover := [for a := left.indices()[] if not left_in[a] then left[a]]
    cover = cover.concat([for b := right.indices()[] if right_in[b] then right[b]])
    emit("COVER size={#cover}" + (if #cover == 0 then "" else " " + cover.join(" ")))
    if #free_left > 0
        hall_left := [for a := left.indices()[] if left_in[a] then left[a]]
        hall_right := [for b := right.indices()[] if right_in[b] then right[b]]
        emit("HALL {hall_left.join(",")} " + (if #hall_right == 0 then "-" else hall_right.join(",")))
    return void

class AssignmentSearch(nat size, string[] values, bool maximize)
    found := false
    best := 0
    nat ways := 0
    nat[] chosen := []

    void .search_branch(nat[] columns, int total)
        row := #columns
        if row == size
            if not found or (if maximize then total > best else total < best)
                found = true
                best = total
                ways = 1
                chosen = columns
            elif total == best
                ways += 1
            return
        for: column < size
            value := values[row * size + column]
            if value == "x" or has_vertex(columns, column)
                continue
            .search_branch(columns.append(column), total + int(value))

void | error assignment_report(string[] args)
    size := nat(args[1])
    if size < 1 or size > 8
        return error("BAD SIZE")
    if #args - 2 != size * size
        return error("BAD LENGTH")
    search := AssignmentSearch(size, args[2:], args[0] == "MAX")
    .search.search_branch([], 0)
    if not search.found
        emit("ASSIGN {args[0]} n={size} infeasible")
        return
    emit("ASSIGN {args[0]} n={size} total={search.best} optimal={search.ways}")
    for: column := search.chosen[row]
        emit("MATE {row + 1} {column + 1} {args[row * size + column + 2]}")
    return void

class Network()
    string[] names := []
    int[] demands := []
    Edge[] edge_list := []
    owner := "none"
    nat source := 0
    nat sink := 0

    nat | error require_node(string name)
        at := word_index(names, name)
        if at == #names
            return error("UNKNOWN NODE {name}")
        return at

    nat | error require_edge(string text)
        number := nat(text)
        if number == 0 or number > #edge_list
            return error("UNKNOWN EDGE {text}")
        return number - 1

    void | error check_endpoints(string first, string last)
        nat a := try require_node(first)
        nat b := try require_node(last)
        if a == b
            return error("SAME NODE")
        return void

    int .start_flow(nat first, nat last)
        if owner != "flow" or source != first or sink != last
            for: i < #edge_list
                edge_list[i].flow = 0
        owner = "flow"
        source = first
        sink = last
        return flow_value(edge_list, source)

    void flow_list()
        for: edge := edge_list[i]
            emit("FLOW {i + 1} {names[edge.u]} {names[edge.v]} {edge.flow}/{edge.capacity}")

    void | error .execute(string line)
        words := line.split(" ")
        command := words[0]
        args := words[1:]
        if command == "NODE"
            seen := names
            for name := args[]
                if has_word(seen, name)
                    return error("DUPLICATE NODE {name}")
                seen = seen.append(name)
            if #names + #args > 20
                return error("TOO MANY NODES")
            names = seen
            demands = demands.concat(array(#args, fill = 0))
            emit("NODE added={#args} total={#names}")
        elif command == "EDGE"
            nat first := try require_node(args[0])
            nat last := try require_node(args[1])
            if first == last
                return error("SELF LOOP")
            if #edge_list == 60
                return error("TOO MANY EDGES")
            int cost := if #args == 4 then int(args[3]) else 0
            edge := Edge(first, last, int(args[2]), cost)
            edge_list = edge_list.append(edge)
            emit("EDGE {#edge_list} {args[0]} {args[1]} cap={edge.capacity} cost={cost}")
        elif command == "LOWER" or command == "CAP" or command == "COST"
            nat at := try require_edge(args[0])
            value := int(args[1])
            edge := edge_list[at]
            if command == "LOWER"
                if value > edge.capacity
                    return error("BAD BOUND")
                edge_list[at].lower = value
                emit("LOWER {at + 1} low={value} cap={edge.capacity}")
            elif command == "CAP"
                if value < edge.lower
                    return error("BAD BOUND")
                if value < edge.flow
                    return error("BELOW FLOW")
                edge_list[at].capacity = value
                emit("CAP {at + 1} low={edge.lower} cap={value}")
            else
                edge_list[at].cost = value
                emit("COST {at + 1} cost={value}")
        elif command == "DEMAND"
            nat at := try require_node(args[0])
            demands[at] = int(args[1])
            total := 0
            for value := demands[]
                total += value
            emit("DEMAND {args[0]} {args[1]} total={total}")
        elif command == "RESET"
            changed := #[for edge := edge_list[] if edge.flow != 0 then edge]
            for: i < #edge_list
                edge_list[i].flow = 0
            owner = "none"
            emit("RESET edges={changed}")
        elif command == "CLEAR"
            emit("CLEAR nodes={#names} edges={#edge_list}")
            names = []
            demands = []
            edge_list = []
            owner = "none"
            source = 0
            sink = 0
        elif command == "SHOW"
            emit("NETWORK nodes={#names} edges={#edge_list}")
            if owner == "none"
                emit("STATE none")
            elif owner == "circulation"
                emit("STATE circulation cost={total_cost(edge_list)}")
            else
                emit("STATE flow {names[source]} {names[sink]} value={flow_value(edge_list, source)} cost={total_cost(edge_list)}")
            for: name := names[vertex]
                emit("NODE {name} demand={demands[vertex]} out={outflow(edge_list, vertex)} in={inflow(edge_list, vertex)}")
            for: edge := edge_list[i]
                emit("EDGE {i + 1} {names[edge.u]} {names[edge.v]} cap={edge.capacity} cost={edge.cost} low={edge.lower} flow={edge.flow}")
        elif command == "AUGMENT" or command == "MAXFLOW" or command == "DINIC" or command == "SCALING" or command == "MINCUT"
            try check_endpoints(args[0], args[1])
            nat first := try require_node(args[0])
            nat last := try require_node(args[1])
            int start := .start_flow(first, last)
            graph := graph_for(#names, edge_list)
            heading := "{command} {args[0]} {args[1]}"
            if command == "AUGMENT"
                item := .graph.augment(first, last)
                edge_list = graph.edge_list
                emit("{heading} value={flow_value(edge_list, first)}" + (if not item.found then " none" else " amount={item.amount} {path_notation(names, edge_list, first, item.path)}"))
                return
            nat phases := 0
            Push[] pushes := []
            if command == "DINIC"
                result := .graph.dinic(first, last)
                phases = result.phases
                pushes = result.pushes
            elif command == "SCALING"
                pushes = .graph.scaling(first, last)
            else
                pushes = .graph.edmonds_karp(first, last)
            edge_list = graph.edge_list
            if command == "MINCUT"
                search := graph.breadth_first(first)
                cut := [for i := edge_list.indices()[] if search.levels[edge_list[i].u] >= 0 and search.levels[edge_list[i].v] < 0 then i]
                emit("{heading} value={flow_value(edge_list, first)} edges={#cut}")
                emit("SOURCE " + [for v := names.indices()[] if search.levels[v] >= 0 then names[v]].join(" "))
                emit("SINK " + [for v := names.indices()[] if search.levels[v] < 0 then names[v]].join(" "))
                for i := cut[]
                    edge := edge_list[i]
                    emit("CUT {i + 1} {names[edge.u]} {names[edge.v]} {edge.capacity}")
            else
                emit("{heading} value={flow_value(edge_list, first)} start={start}" + (if command == "DINIC" then " phases={phases}" else "") + " paths={#pushes}")
                for: item := pushes[i]
                    detail := if command == "DINIC" then " phase={item.marker}" else (if command == "SCALING" then " delta={item.marker}" else "")
                    emit("AUG {i + 1}{detail} amount={item.amount} {path_notation(names, edge_list, first, item.path)}")
                flow_list()
        elif command == "SENSITIVITY"
            try check_endpoints(args[0], args[1])
            nat first := try require_node(args[0])
            nat last := try require_node(args[1])
            value := maximum_amount(#names, fresh_edges(edge_list), first, last)
            bool[] up := []
            bool[] down := []
            for: edge := edge_list[i]
                work := fresh_edges(edge_list)
                work[i].capacity += 1
                up = up.append(maximum_amount(#names, work, first, last) > value)
                effective := false
                if edge.capacity > 0
                    work = fresh_edges(edge_list)
                    work[i].capacity -= 1
                    effective = maximum_amount(#names, work, first, last) < value
                down = down.append(effective)
            ups := #[for flag := up[] if flag then flag]
            downs := #[for flag := down[] if flag then flag]
            emit("SENSITIVITY {args[0]} {args[1]} value={value} up={ups} down={downs}")
            for: edge := edge_list[i]
                if up[i] or down[i]
                    emit("CRITICAL {i + 1} {names[edge.u]} {names[edge.v]} up={yes_no(up[i])} down={yes_no(down[i])}")
        elif command == "MINCOST"
            try check_endpoints(args[0], args[1])
            nat first := try require_node(args[0])
            nat last := try require_node(args[1])
            if negative_cycle(#names, [for edge := edge_list[] if edge.capacity > 0 then edge])
                return error("NEGATIVE CYCLE")
            int target := if args[2] == "MAX" then -1 else int(args[2])
            graph := graph_for(#names, fresh_edges(edge_list))
            result := .graph.minimum_cost(first, last, target)
            heading := "MINCOST {args[0]} {args[1]} k={args[2]}"
            if target >= 0 and result.amount < target
                emit("{heading} infeasible max={result.amount}")
                return
            for: i < #edge_list
                edge_list[i].flow = graph.edge_list[i].flow
            owner = "flow"
            source = first
            sink = last
            emit("{heading} flow={result.amount} cost={result.cost}")
            for: item := result.pushes[i]
                emit("AUG {i + 1} amount={item.amount} cost={item.unit_cost} {path_notation(names, edge_list, first, item.path)}")
            flow_list()
        elif command == "DISJOINT"
            try check_endpoints(args[0], args[1])
            nat first := try require_node(args[0])
            nat last := try require_node(args[1])
            exits := [for v := (nat(0):<#names)[] then v]
            count := #names
            if args[2] == "VERTEX"
                count *= 2
                for: v < #names
                    if v != first and v != last
                        exits[v] = #names + v
            work := [for edge := edge_list[] then Edge(exits[edge.u], edge.v, if edge.capacity > 0 then 1 else 0)]
            if args[2] == "VERTEX"
                for: v < #names
                    if v != first and v != last
                        work = work.append(Edge(v, exits[v], 1))
            graph := graph_for(count, work)
            ignored := .graph.edmonds_karp(first, last)
            pieces := [for item := decompose(count, graph.edge_list)[] if not item.cycle then item]
            emit("DISJOINT {args[0]} {args[1]} {args[2]} count={#pieces}")
            for: item := pieces[i]
                path := [for index := item.edges[] if index < #edge_list then int(index + 1)]
                emit("PATH {i + 1} {path_notation(names, edge_list, item.origin, path)}")
        elif command == "DECOMPOSE"
            pieces := decompose(#names, edge_list)
            cycles := #[for item := pieces[] if item.cycle then item]
            emit("DECOMPOSE paths={#pieces - cycles} cycles={cycles}")
            nat paths := 0
            nat cycle_count := 0
            for item := pieces[]
                title := ""
                if item.cycle
                    cycle_count += 1
                    title = "CYCLE {cycle_count}"
                else
                    paths += 1
                    title = "PATH {paths}"
                path := [for index := item.edges[] then int(index + 1)]
                emit("{title} amount={item.amount} {path_notation(names, edge_list, item.origin, path)}")
        elif command == "VERIFY"
            string[] violations := []
            for: edge := edge_list[i]
                if edge.flow < edge.lower
                    violations = violations.append("LOW {i + 1} flow={edge.flow} low={edge.lower}")
            for: name := names[vertex]
                if owner == "flow" and (vertex == source or vertex == sink)
                    continue
                need := if owner == "flow" then 0 else demands[vertex]
                net := inflow(edge_list, vertex) - outflow(edge_list, vertex)
                if net != need
                    violations = violations.append("BALANCE {name} net={net} need={need}")
            if #violations == 0
                emit("VERIFY ok")
            else
                emit("VERIFY violations={#violations}")
                for violation := violations[]
                    emit(violation)
        elif command == "CIRCULATION"
            if args[0] == "MINCOST" and negative_cycle(#names, [for edge := edge_list[] if edge.capacity > edge.lower then edge])
                return error("NEGATIVE CYCLE")
            imbalance := 0
            for demand := demands[]
                imbalance += demand
            if imbalance != 0
                emit("CIRCULATION infeasible unbalanced={imbalance}")
                return
            required := demands
            Edge[] work := []
            for edge := edge_list[]
                required[edge.v] -= edge.lower
                required[edge.u] += edge.lower
                work = work.append(Edge(edge.u, edge.v, edge.capacity - edge.lower, edge.cost))
            for: value := required[v]
                if value < 0
                    work = work.append(Edge(#names, v, -value))
            nat[] sink_edges := []
            total := 0
            for: value := required[v]
                if value > 0
                    sink_edges = sink_edges.append(#work)
                    work = work.append(Edge(v, #names + 1, value))
                    total += value
            graph := graph_for(#names + 2, work)
            if args[0] == "ANY"
                ignored := .graph.edmonds_karp(#names, #names + 1)
            else
                ignored := .graph.minimum_cost(#names, #names + 1)
            achieved := 0
            for i := sink_edges[]
                achieved += graph.edge_list[i].flow
            if achieved < total
                emit("CIRCULATION infeasible required={total} achieved={achieved}")
                search := graph.breadth_first(#names)
                emit("CUT " + [for v := names.indices()[] if search.levels[v] >= 0 then names[v]].join(" "))
                return
            for: i < #edge_list
                edge_list[i].flow = edge_list[i].lower + graph.edge_list[i].flow
            owner = "circulation"
            emit("CIRCULATION feasible required={total} cost={total_cost(edge_list)}")
            flow_list()
        elif command == "MATCH"
            try matching_report(args)
        elif command == "ASSIGN"
            try assignment_report(args)
        return void
